Here are the latest news and big news stories to follow

PM Modi to attend centenary celebrations of Shri Ram College of Commerce on Saturday

Prime Minister Narendra Modi will participate in the centenary celebrations of Delhi University’s Shri Ram College of Commerce (SRCC) on Saturday. The centenary celebrations coincide with Teachers’ Day, making the occasion particularly significant.

Bengaluru SIR: 100% notices generated, but names still withheld from public domain

While Karnataka Chief Electoral Officer (CEO) V. Anbu Kumar said that nobody, including him, would know who is getting a notice until it is generated, data from the CEO’s office shows that 100% of the notices had been generated as of Friday, suggesting that all names are with the authorities now. With hearings having begun at the district level from Thursday and set to begin in Bengaluru on Saturday, voters, however, still do not know whether their names have been flagged for an anomaly or logical discrepancy, or whether their 2002 electoral roll details could not be mapped – situations that would result in a notice being issued.

From Cabinet to classroom: Keralam Ministers in student mode for two-day session at IIM-K

Revisiting their student days, the Council of Ministers of Keralam turned up at the Indian Institute of Management-Kozhikode (IIM-K) on Friday for a strategic two-day leadership retreat that brought the State’s political leadership together with academics and international experts to discuss the challenges and opportunities shaping Keralam’s future. Chief Minister V.D. Satheesan and his 20 Ministerial colleagues took part in the first day of the two-day residential retreat, titled ‘Reimagining Keralam,’ organised by the IIM-K. The first day’s sessions focussed on a range of topics, including artificial intelligence, governance, health care and wellness, climate resilience, disaster preparedness, ageing and future economic opportunities. According to the training coordinators, the second day of the retreat on Saturday will focus on Keralam’s economic, employment, education and global positioning priorities.

Shami to be felicitated by CAB on 100th first-class appearance

India’s pace-bowling stalwart Mohammed Shami will be felicitated by the Cricket Association of Bengal (CAB) in Chennai on Saturday for reaching the milestone of 100 first-class appearances, a day ahead of the Duleep Trophy final between East Zone and South Zone at the M.A. Chidambaram Stadium.

Women’s Asia Cup: India favourites against arch-foes Pakistan

Having already made the semifinals, a far superior India will be expected to step up the intensity against traditional foes Pakistan in their final league game of the Women’s Asia Cup in Dubai on Saturday.
